measures.title: Beaufort County one percent special sales and use tax for transportation projects
measures.summary: Would impose a one percent special sales and use tax in Beaufort County for up to nine years, or until $780,000,000 is collected, whichever comes first. The revenue would pay for listed transportation projects: intersection and safety projects ($326 million), road widening projects ($205 million), and resurfacing and dirt road paving projects ($249 million).
measures.yesMeans: A one percent special sales and use tax would be imposed in Beaufort County for up to nine years to fund the listed transportation projects.
measures.noMeans: The special sales and use tax would not be imposed.

measures.title: Beaufort County general obligation bonds payable from the special sales and use tax
measures.summary: Would authorize Beaufort County to issue up to $450,000,000 in general obligation bonds, maturing over no more than nine years. The bonds would be repaid from the special sales and use tax in Question 1 and used to complete projects from the categories listed in Question 1.
measures.yesMeans: Beaufort County could issue up to $450 million in bonds, repaid from the special sales tax, to complete the listed transportation projects.
measures.noMeans: The county would not be authorized to issue these bonds.
